items.question: How long does dressing and hair take?
items.answer: Plan for 30–40 minutes to dress and 20 minutes for light hair/makeup.

items.question: Do you store personal items?
items.answer: Yes, personal lockers are available during your rental.

items.question: What if it rains?
items.answer: You can reschedule for free up to 24 hours before, subject to availability.

items.question: Are plus sizes available?
items.answer: We carry sizes up to 185cm height and plus-size fittings. Leave a note when booking.

items.question: Can I extend the rental after the shoot?
items.answer: Yes, extension options are available with a small fee. Please ask our staff.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept major credit cards, cash, and popular Japanese e-wallets.
